name: Morgana the Abyssal Siren
source:
Morgana the Abyssal Siren is a mystery wrapped in darkness, an enchantress who seems to lure sailors and merchant ships into the void. Her allure, made of hypnotic singing and seductive promises, leads the unsuspecting to get lost at sea. Sailors are then found on the shore, stripped of all goods and with no memory of what happened. No one knows whether she is a supernatural creature or a woman playing with fear and despair, but her fame grows every time another cargo mysteriously disappears into the abyss.

[In game description]
